tasks.title: Fix v1->v2 config migration losing custom keys

declaration.objective: Fix v1->v2 config migration in cfgmigrate/migrate.py so it preserves unrelated user-defined keys (e.g. 'custom') recursively, renames timeout->request_timeout, sets version=2, and does not mutate the input object; add regression coverage for unknown-key preservation.

criteria.statement: Preserve all unrelated user-defined keys recursively.
Do not mutate the input object.
Add regression coverage for preservation of unknown keys.

claims.statement: Rewrote _v1_to_v2 in cfgmigrate/migrate.py to deep-copy the input, rename timeout->request_timeout, set version=2, default plugins to [] if missing, and preserve all other keys (e.g. custom) recursively without mutating the input. Added regression tests for unknown top-level key preservation, nested key preservation, and non-mutation of the input. Full pytest suite (13 tests) passes.

Rewrote _v1_to_v2 in cfgmigrate/migrate.py to deep-copy the input (no input mutation), rename timeout->request_timeout, set version=2, default plugins to [] if missing, and preserve all other keys (e.g. custom) recursively. Added regression tests (test_preserves_unknown_top_level_keys, test_preserves_nested_unknown_keys_recursively, test_does_not_mutate_input). Full pytest suite (13 tests, including 3 new) passes; manually reproduced the exact example from ISSUE.md and confirmed output matches expected and input dict is untouched.

confidence.rationale: python -m pytest -v: 13/13 passed, including the 3 new regression tests (test_preserves_unknown_top_level_keys, test_preserves_nested_unknown_keys_recursively, test_does_not_mutate_input). Manually reproduced the exact ISSUE.md example: migrating {version:1, timeout:30, plugins:[foo], custom:{owner:peter}} yields {version:2, request_timeout:30, plugins:[foo], custom:{owner:peter}} and confirmed the input dict is unchanged after the call.
